title: How to grow a bean plant
text:
You will need:
a small pot with a hole in the bottom
some soil
one bean seed
a little water

What to do:
1. First, fill the pot with soil. Leave a small space at the top.
2. Next, push your finger into the soil to make a hole about two centimetres deep.
3. Then put the seed in the hole and cover it with soil.
4. After that, water the soil gently.
5. Finally, put the pot in a warm, bright place. Check it every day. If the soil feels dry, add a little water.

In about one week, a small green shoot will push up through the soil.
